title: My edition
intro: This is your edition. Change anything by asking.
writingLines: Sorting it into what you follow and what you do not

sections.heading: What I follow
lines: Tech, the companies mostly: what they ship, who they hire, and what it does to work.
The harbor council, from the tide barrier vote to the ferry timetable.

sections.heading: Less of
lines: Celebrity gossip. Sports, unless my team makes the final.

sections.heading: Sources
lines: I trust the public radio. I would rather not see the tabloids.

sections.heading: When I listen
lines: Mornings on the train, about twenty minutes.
